edits.old: These nine criteria are new for the `rwb-decision` slice
edits.new: These fifteen criteria are new for the `rwb-decision` slice

edits.old: Then the text and the file stay in rwb_document behind the masked read of the item
edits.new:
Then the text and the file stay in rwb_document behind the masked read of the item

  Scenario: AC14 The record path, the append-only chain, the no-match rule, the fail-closed write and the ledger check hold (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a DecisionRecorded fact for document "DOC-2026-0009981" of case "RW-2026-000123" carries the outcome that rwb-document decided
    When the listener writes the entry for that fact
    Then the entry, its chain position and its outbox row commit in one transaction on the DP-03 path and the entry names the rule and the rule version in force
    Then the entry copies the outcome of rwb-document, and the service applies no pattern, threshold or review rule of its own
    Then the service writes no row to rwb_document, rwb_case or rwb_access and reads no table of another service
    Then each entry_hash equals the SHA-256 of the canonical form and no UPDATE or DELETE of an entry succeeds
    Then a failed append leaves no entry and no chain position, and the fact is redelivered
    Then the ledger check reports a document of the case with no DOCATT entry in the ingest window as a gap, alerts it, and writes no entry for it

  Scenario: AC15 A read without a credential answers 401 and an unknown entry answers 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the entries of AC1 exist for case "RW-2026-000123"
    When GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log for case "RW-2026-000123" is called without a credential
    Then the answer is 401 and no row is returned
    When GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log/{entryId} is called with an entry ID that is not in rwb_decision
    Then the answer is 404 and no row is returned
